description: Compute signup cohort sizes by month and acquisition channel for the subscription service. A cohort is defined by the UTC month of signup_ts. Count only users with email_verified = TRUE. Users with a NULL channel_id, or a channel_id that has no match in channels, are reported under channel_name = 'unknown'. Output columns: cohort_month (DATE), channel_name (STRING), cohort_size (INT64). Sort by cohort_month, channel_name.

channel_id.description: Foreign key to channels; NULL when attribution failed

email_verified.description: Whether the user verified their email

edge_cases: Signup at 2025-01-31T23:30Z belongs to the January cohort in UTC
Users with NULL channel_id must be kept under 'unknown'
Unverified users are excluded even if they are the only user of a cohort
common_failure_modes: FM1: INNER JOIN to channels drops users with NULL or unmatched channel_id
FM2: Truncating the month in a non-UTC timezone moves end-of-month signups into the next cohort
